name: FFS_WMT_BANNER
description: Stores banner images for a WMT theme.

columns.name: BANNER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of WMT banner. Sequence generated ID.

columns.name: THEME_LABEL
columns.description: Unique identifier of WMT theme to which the banner belongs to.

columns.name: CONTENT
columns.description: Binary content of the banner's file.

columns.name: CONTENT_SIZE
columns.description: Indicates banner's file size in bytes.

columns.name: CONTENT_HASH
columns.description: Unique hash of the banner's file. Used for ETag HTTP header.

columns.name: CREATED_AT
columns.description: Indicates date and time when the banner's file has been uploaded. Used for Last-Modified HTTP header.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
